description: One lease, in either direction: ground let out to an operator, or ground taken in from another party. Direction is recorded rather than inferred, because 'who is the lessor' is the question every downstream reading of the record depends on and a guess from a name string is not an answer.

fields.description: What this lease is called in conversation: 'Mill Creek Ground Lease 2025'. The docname is built from this and the owning entity's abbreviation.
fields.label: Lease Name

fields.description: The company whose books this lease belongs to — the party on our side of it, whichever side that is.
fields.label: Owning Entity

fields.description: The ground this lease covers, when it is one recorded parcel. Left empty for a lease over land that is not on this site's Parcel register, or over several parcels.
fields.label: Parcel

fields.description: Outbound: the owning entity is the LESSOR, letting ground out and collecting rent. Inbound: the owning entity is the LESSEE, taking ground in and paying rent.
fields.label: Direction

fields.description: Active until somebody says otherwise. An expiration date in the past does not flip this by itself — a lease running month to month past its stated term is the normal case in farming, and a status that changed on a calendar rather than on a fact would hide it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The party letting the ground out, by legal name.
fields.label: Lessor

fields.description: The party taking the ground in, by legal name.
fields.label: Lessee

fields.description: The other side of this lease in the Related Party register, when they are one. A lease between two entities the same family controls is a related-party transaction and has to be disclosable as one.
fields.label: Counterparty

fields.description: When the stated term ends. Empty for a lease with no fixed end.
fields.label: Expiration Date

fields.description: When it was actually ended early, which is a different fact from when the term was going to run out.
fields.label: Termination Date

fields.description: Rent per period, at the frequency beside it. A crop-share lease has no fixed amount; leave it empty and put the share in Rent Terms.
fields.label: Rent Amount
Rent Frequency
fields.options:
Monthly
Quarterly
Semi-Annual
Annual
One-Time
Crop Share
Other

fields.description: Escalators, crop-share percentages, who pays the water assessment, what happens to the trees at the end. The part of a farm lease that is never a number.
fields.label: Rent Terms

fields.description: The executed lease itself. Uploaded content is stored as a private File attached to this record.
fields.label: Lease Document

fields.description: The archive entry for this lease, when it has been filed as a Governance Document. Amendments chain there rather than here.
fields.label: Governance Document

name: Lease
